newsitem.title: USA: Sun Microsystems unveils network computer.
newsitem.headline: Sun Microsystems unveils network computer.

text.p: Sun Microsystems Inc. said Tuesday it introduced its first network computer, called the JavaStation.
The scaled-down personal computer, designed to access corporate networks and the Internet, carries a price tag of $742, the company said.

Sun said the entry level model, containing eight megabytes of memory, will ship beginning in December. A fully configured system, which includes memory, keyboard, a mouse and fourteen-inch monitor will cost $995.
The company also said it will offer a JavaStation with 16 megabytes of memory for $1,565.
